understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked `+` in the current level (BP35) without dying, using at most 2 attempts and within 50 turns per attempt, then continue clearing subsequent levels until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose an action (move or click). MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN moves the player one tile if possible; after moving, gravity (shown as a direction, e.g. DOWN) causes the player to fall/slide along that gravity direction until supported, which can result in larger position changes than a single step. CLICK on a target coordinate removes any clickable tile(s) at that position (e.g., breakable/interactive blocks), altering the map so future movement/gravity resolves differently; clicking does not directly move the player but still consumes a turn. Landing on a spike tile immediately ends the attempt (failure) and restarts the level for the next attempt. Each attempt has a 50-turn limit; if the goal isn’t reached in time or you die, the attempt ends and the level resets. UNDO (when available) would revert the most recent action/state change (position and any map changes from clicks), effectively taking back a move to try a different line.
